item.description:
Bento for macOS 0.2.13
What’s new
- Keep valid window moves committed when macOS briefly returns the dragged window to its old position. - Improve fast drags and split drops when window focus changes late. - Pause background rearrangement while dragging and ignore brief window-discovery gaps. - Keep split previews stable and reuse their geometry, with fewer native frame reads and redraws. - Apply the final drop once after mouse-up, including the last native resize position. - Recover cleanly when a source or target closes during a gesture, and add local interaction tracing for QA.
